name: all-in-one
description: Prompt Uplift on every prompt with the Grok 4.6 Ultra thinking engine (grok-4.6 @ xhigh over your SuperGrok OAuth): rewrites the request into an XML spec, builds a Graph of Thought with per-node Chain of Thought and a parallel-wave workflow, asks HITL clarifications through AskUserQuestion, opens a markdown parent issue plus one sub-issue per node under issues/ (synced to ktui when present), and serves Claude Code's Haiku tier through a local Grok proxy.
